Primary analysis presented at SABCS 2022 (abstract GS5-01, Cancer Res supplement dated 2023-03-01): 720 randomised, 5-year DFS 70.6% vs 64.5%, HR 0.79 (0.61-1.02), p=0.073, not significant; OS HR 0.75. Full paper J Clin Oncol epub 2025-10-20 (PMID 41115255, EFS HR 0.80, 'prespecified primary analysis'). Date given is the supplement issue I opened; the oral presentation was in December 2022 and was not opened. Registry still shows active not recruiting.

CanariaBio shareholder notice of 2024-02-29 states that on 2024-01-17 (interim result announcement date) the DSMB recommended stopping the oregovomab global phase 3 after the futility analysis failed the required P-value; dosing stopped, 378 cohort-1 patients in follow-up. The Bell (2025-05-29) confirms no significant PFS difference at the interim and a later DSMB revision to 'continue with modifications' with no new enrolment. Date given is the earliest notice I opened; the original 2024-01-17 KRX filing was not opened. Registry still active not recruiting.

J&J statement of 2024-10-07: SunRISe-2 discontinued after a pre-specified interim analysis and IDMC recommendation, 'for not showing superiority versus chemoradiation'. Repeated in Ther Deliv industry update (PMC11849935). J&J pipeline of 2026-07-15 no longer lists it. Registry still shows active not recruiting with no 'why stopped'.

Ipsen release of 2026-03-09: on IDMC advice (secondary haematologic malignancies, risks may outweigh benefits) tazemetostat stopped for all SYMPHONY-1 patients and Tazverik withdrawn worldwide; no PFS or other efficacy result given; study stays open without enrolment for safety follow-up. Clin Cancer Res commentary (2026-08-14) reports 18/318 (5.7%) haematologic second malignancies vs 0 and no efficacy data. Ipsen H1 2026 results do not mention it. Medium because the trial is formally still open (registry active, updated 2026-10-05) and a later efficacy disclosure could not be excluded without a web search.

ASCO 2024 abstract 4000 (J Clin Oncol 42, 16_suppl, issue dated 2024-06-01) reports the step 1 primary endpoint: pCR 21.0% without vs 24.8% with nivolumab, p=0.27, not improved (275 enrolled). The step 2 primary (DFS, nivolumab vs nivolumab+ipilimumab) is 'to be reported once mature' and nothing was found for it. Counted as read out because one of two primary endpoints is public. Date is the supplement issue date; the abstract went online about a week earlier, not opened. Registry 'suspended: end of initial phase'.
